passages.title: Preparing for a Safe School Walk
passages.text:
The school health club has prepared a short walking route for a supervised group. The guide is for a school activity; it is not a personal fitness or medical plan. Before leaving, check the weather and confirm the route with the teacher. Wear comfortable shoes and bring a refillable water bottle.

First, meet at the marked starting point and listen to the instructions. Then walk at a comfortable pace, stay on the marked path, and remain with the group. Do not run through crowded areas or leave the group without permission.

If the path is wet or blocked, stop and tell the teacher. The group must use an alternative route approved by the school. If anyone feels dizzy or unwell, stop in a safe place and inform the teacher; do not pressure that student to continue.

At the end, slow down and return to the meeting point. The teacher checks that everyone has arrived before the group returns to class. Follow school directions and any individual support arrangements.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the guide?
choices: To give steps for a supervised and safe school walk.
To describe the history of a sports club.
To compare different types of running shoes.
To create a personal fitness plan for every student.
questions.explanation: Kalimat pembuka menyebutkan rute jalan kaki singkat untuk kelompok yang diawasi. Teks kemudian memberikan persiapan, urutan, dan respons terhadap kondisi tertentu.

choices: Memberikan langkah untuk kegiatan jalan kaki sekolah yang aman dan diawasi.
Mendeskripsikan sejarah sebuah klub olahraga.
Membandingkan berbagai jenis sepatu lari.
Membuat rencana kebugaran pribadi bagi setiap siswa.

questions.evidence: The school health club has prepared a short walking route for a supervised group.

questions.prompt: What should students do before leaving?
choices: Start walking before the teacher arrives.
Check the weather and confirm the route with the teacher.
Leave their water bottles in the classroom.
Choose an unmarked shortcut.
questions.explanation: Dua tindakan tersebut dinyatakan setelah penanda before leaving. Siswa juga diminta memakai sepatu nyaman dan membawa botol minum.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang harus dilakukan siswa sebelum berangkat?
choices: Mulai berjalan sebelum guru tiba.
Memeriksa cuaca dan memastikan rute bersama guru.
Meninggalkan botol minum di kelas.
Memilih jalan pintas yang tidak ditandai.

questions.evidence: Before leaving, check the weather and confirm the route with the teacher.

questions.prompt: Which action is expressly prohibited by the guide?
choices: Walking at a comfortable pace.
Bringing a refillable water bottle.
Running through crowded areas or leaving the group without permission.
Listening to the teacher at the starting point.
questions.explanation: Kalimat menggunakan do not untuk melarang siswa berlari di area ramai atau meninggalkan kelompok tanpa izin.

translationId.prompt: Tindakan mana yang secara tegas dilarang oleh panduan?
choices: Berjalan dengan kecepatan yang nyaman.
Membawa botol minum yang dapat diisi ulang.
Berlari di area ramai atau meninggalkan kelompok tanpa izin.
Mendengarkan guru di titik awal.

questions.evidence: Do not run through crowded areas or leave the group without permission.

questions.prompt: What should the group do if the path is wet or blocked?
choices: Continue without telling anyone.
Run to finish the walk quickly.
Separate and find different routes.
Stop, tell the teacher, and use an alternative route approved by the school.
questions.explanation: Kondisi if the path is wet or blocked diikuti dua tindakan: berhenti dan memberi tahu guru. Kelompok kemudian harus menggunakan rute alternatif yang disetujui sekolah.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang harus dilakukan kelompok jika jalurnya basah atau terhalang?
choices: Melanjutkan tanpa memberi tahu siapa pun.
Berlari agar kegiatan cepat selesai.
Berpisah dan mencari rute masing-masing.
Berhenti, memberi tahu guru, dan menggunakan rute alternatif yang disetujui sekolah.

questions.evidence: If the path is wet or blocked, stop and tell the teacher.

questions.prompt: What should happen if a student feels dizzy or unwell?
choices: The student must continue to keep up with the group.
The student should stop in a safe place and inform the teacher.
Other students should pressure the student to finish.
The student should leave the school grounds alone.
questions.explanation: Panduan meminta siswa berhenti di tempat aman dan memberi tahu guru. Teks juga melarang orang lain menekan siswa tersebut untuk terus berjalan.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang harus dilakukan jika seorang siswa merasa pusing atau tidak sehat?
choices: Siswa harus terus berjalan agar tidak tertinggal.
Siswa harus berhenti di tempat aman dan memberi tahu guru.
Siswa lain sebaiknya menekan siswa itu agar menyelesaikan kegiatan.
Siswa sebaiknya meninggalkan lingkungan sekolah sendirian.

questions.evidence: If anyone feels dizzy or unwell, stop in a safe place and inform the teacher

questions.prompt: In “The group must use an alternative route”, what does must communicate?
choices: A strong requirement within the guide.
A weak possibility.
A personal preference.
A past action.
questions.explanation: Must menyatakan keharusan yang kuat dalam konteks panduan. Kalimat tersebut bukan sekadar saran atau pilihan pribadi.

translationId.prompt: Dalam kalimat “The group must use an alternative route”, apa makna must?
choices: Keharusan yang kuat dalam panduan.
Kemungkinan yang lemah.
Pilihan pribadi.
Tindakan pada masa lampau.

questions.evidence: The group must use an alternative route approved by the school.

questions.prompt: Why does the teacher check that everyone has arrived before the group returns to class?
choices: To give students more time to run.
To change the walking route after the activity.
To make sure the supervised group is accounted for.
To compare the students’ water bottles.
questions.explanation: Teks menyebutkan bahwa kegiatan dilakukan oleh kelompok yang diawasi dan guru memeriksa bahwa semua orang telah tiba sebelum kembali ke kelas. Dari kedua rincian itu, pembaca dapat menyimpulkan bahwa guru memastikan seluruh anggota kelompok sudah kembali.

translationId.prompt: Mengapa guru memeriksa bahwa semua orang telah tiba sebelum kelompok kembali ke kelas?
choices: Untuk memberi siswa lebih banyak waktu berlari.
Untuk mengubah rute setelah kegiatan.
Untuk memastikan seluruh anggota kelompok yang diawasi sudah kembali.
Untuk membandingkan botol minum siswa.

questions.skill: Inference and purpose of a step
questions.evidence: The teacher checks that everyone has arrived before the group returns to class.
